finding: Form ADV has separate parts for separate jobs: Part 1 (check-the-box business, ownership and disciplinary data, public on IAPD), Part 2A (a plain-English brochure of 18 items in a fixed order covering services, fees, conflicts, strategies and risk, discipline and personal trading, the primary disclosure document), Part 2B (a supplement on the individuals who advise you) and Part 3 (a short relationship summary); reading the brochure first answers the questions that matter most before hiring, which is an editorial ordering, not an SEC instruction.
conditions: US readers; SEC- or state-registered advisers only; exempt advisers and broker-dealers use other filings; no form-item detail beyond the SEC bulletin is asserted.
whatWouldChange: The adviser being unregistered or broker-only, SEC form revisions, or a new disciplinary event in the filing.
